mcq.passage: The prevalence of food allergies in the nation has nearly doubled within a decade, while peanut sensitivity is on the 21 among young children, according to Linkou Chang Gung Memorial Hospital. From 2004 to 2017, the percentage of those aged 4 to 18 with food allergies 22 from 7.7 to 10.4 percent, Director Su, Kuan-wen of the Division of Pediatric Allergy, Immunology, and Rheumatology told a news conference. Among adults, the percentage increased from 6.4 to 12.5 percent over the period, he said, citing a survey with 16,800 23 responses. The percentage increases are roughly on a par with global trends, as most nations have seen a two to fivefold increase in recent decades, Su said. Genetics cannot fully account for the rapid increase, meaning that environmental factors are a 24 cause, he said. The top three food allergies among elementary school students treated at the hospital were shellfish, peanuts, and eggs, he said. However, among junior high school students and adults, the top three were shellfish, fish, and peanuts 25 , he added. “ This shows that nut allergies are becoming more common among the younger generation, negating the belief that such allergies are only prevalent in other nations,”Su said.

mcq.passage: The recent controversies surrounding priority seats on public transportation in Taiwan have highlighted the need for clearer guidelines and better public understanding of their purpose. While the“People with Disabilities Rights Protection Act” 26 the provision of priority seats on public transportation, the law does not specify who is eligible to 27 them. Despite the frequent news of people fighting over priority seats, the Welfare Ministry in Taiwan has stated that priority seats will not be abolished, but 28 to the law may be considered. In the face of recent controversies, it’s about time to consider expanding the definition of“those with actual needs”to include more groups, which has been proposed but was not passed by the previous legislature. In addition to top-down legal regulations, it is also important to 29 a spirit of mutual understanding from the bottom up through public education. Everyone needs to learn to identify who is most in need, and should not hastily judge who is eligible to sit in priority seating based solely on age and appearance. To better avoid unnecessary conflicts and misunderstandings, clearer guidelines, public education, and a spirit of mutual respect among passengers are all 30 . Only through collective effort can we create a more inclusive and considerate public transportation environment.

mcq.passage: Goblin mode is a concept that has gained significant attention in recent years, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. During the coronavirus lockdown, going into goblin mode refers to enjoying being stuck at home with minimal social contacts. With the progression of the pandemic, this term gradually evolved. It eventually came to refer to a state of being where individuals embrace a more unapologetic and self-indulgent way of living, often showing no deference to societal expectations and norms. One of the primary strengths of goblin mode is that it can serve as a form of self-care and a way to recharge. In a world that often demands constant productivity, success, and the presentation of a perfect version of oneself, goblin mode can be a liberating experience. It allows individuals to embrace their“inner goblin” and engage in activities that bring them comfort and pleasure, without the pressure to conform to societal expectations. However, the weakness of goblin mode as a way of life are also significant. While embracing one’s inner goblin can be a form of self-care, it can also lead to unhealthy habits, seclusion, alienation and a lack of self-improvement. Completely rejecting societal norms and expectations can have negative consequences, such as development of addictions, poor holistic health, and strained relationships. In conclusion, goblin mode is a complex concept that reflects the stiff challenges and unrelenting pressures of modern life. While it can serve a form of self-care, it is important to strike a balance instead of completely breaking from societal norms. Embracing goblin mode in moderation can be a healthy way to recharge and reconnect with oneself, but it should not become a permanent way of life.

opts: It allows for complete rest after strenuous work.
It helps build up a trouble-free relationship.
It teaches you how to let go and bravely be yourself.
It allows you to break free from the constraints of socially accepted values.
